description: Retrieve full-text Yelp customer reviews, star distribution, sentiment polarity breakdown, useful/funny/cool votes, and owner replies by Yelp business_id, alias, or yelp.com/biz URL (bypasses the official Yelp Fusion 3-review cap). Cost: 2 Credits / review returned.

business_id.description: Yelp business_id (e.g. "p88l_DLOIB-yL3Ka8GbGDw"), slug alias (e.g. "desnudo-coffee-austin-2"), or full yelp.com/biz/... URL.

name: yelp_reviews

data.description: Normalized reviews payload containing target metadata, sentiment_summary (star_distribution and polarity_breakdown), and paginated reviews array.

meta.description: Gateway billing and cache telemetry (credits_charged, credits_remaining, cache hit/miss, latency_ms).

title: Extract Full Yelp Customer Reviews (Bypassing 3-Review Cap)
